notes.title: Big Languages Update
notes.notes:
We've added new localizations, including:

- French

- Italian

- German

- Spanish

- Japanese

- Korean

- Polish

- Portuguese - Brazil

- Simplified Chinese

- Traditional Chinese

- Turkish



Thank you for playing EmyLiveShow visual novels ❤️

notes.title: April update
notes.notes:
Updated save system, controller support, and other improvements
- Added more slots to save/load the game at any time
- Added controller support 
- Fixed reset progress function, now it shouldn't reset resolution, customization and language settings
